Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

We acknowledge your renewal offer and your approval requirements for price changes. Please submit our price proposal to your pricing committee for approval; alongside this, we seek a longer agreement term, extended payment terms and greater call-off flexibility.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months, 13,740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 427.22 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. This amounts to about EUR 5,870,003 over the term.
3. Basis: Our should-cost estimate for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020). Our demand forecast for this part rose +23.3% in 2026-06 (fc:350020@2026-06); our latest forecast (2026-09) gives 4,580 units a year, which we commit as a binding volume. Producer prices DE: electronic components changed -3.0% from 2025-01 to 2025-09 (idx:PPI-C2611@2025-01, idx:PPI-C2611@2025-09).
4. Next step: You told us that price changes above 2% need your pricing committee. Please put this proposal to your pricing committee: a binding 36-month agreement for 13,740 units, about EUR 5,870,003. On the committee's written confirmation we issue the order the same day, and we pay every invoice on the due date.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data and should cost data you cited; both hold and were taken into account. However, the index change data you cite does not concern this part or our company, and the index data you referenced pertains to an outdated timeframe and cannot be applied to our current cost structures. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Furthermore, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. 

We acknowledge your commitment to a 36-month contract, which allows us to optimize our long-term planning. Our Angebot stands at a price of €432.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €431.07 per unit. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

We acknowledge your review of our proposal and your management’s price freeze, with contractual terms remaining open for discussion. Please take our revised price back to your pricing committee for a decision, while continuing discussions with us on payment terms, contract duration and call-off flexibility.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months, 13,740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 428.12 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. This amounts to about EUR 5,882,369 over the term.
3. Basis: Copper notation for cables and motors (derived) changed -2.2% from 2026-01 to 2026-03 (idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-01, idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-03).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified the CU-NOTATION data you cited; however, its minimal change has a negligible effect on our overall cost structure. 

As previously communicated, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027, which restricts our ability to accommodate your target price. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. That remains. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.

We can offer a slight adjustment to a price of €432.49 per unit for the a contract term of 36 months with Zahlungsziel 90 days net and a volume of 4580 pcs per year. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

We note your management’s freeze on price reductions and your willingness to discuss contractual terms. Please submit our revised price to your pricing committee for renewed review and propose payment terms, contract duration and call-off flexibility that support a stable frame agreement.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months, 13,740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 432.15 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. This amounts to about EUR 5,937,741 over the term.
